tagline: A simpler, leaner and more focused business, with a clear and resilient strategy, delivering exceptional returns on capital employed.
hero_kpi_rationale: DCC Energy generates robust adjusted operating profit of GBP 617.5 million (+2.9% YoY), demonstrating resilient performance despite the energy transition. This structural growth is supported by a capital return strategy of 15.3% ROCE and a target adjusted operating profit growth of 10% annually, reflecting the strength of the energy-centric business model.

kpis.name: Adjusted Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Operating profit excluding exceptional items and intangible asset amortization.
kpis.description: DCC Energy starts 2025 with adjusted operating profit of GBP 617.5 million, up 2.9% from GBP 600.2 million in the prior year, reflecting robust performance despite sector headwinds.
kpis.signal: Solid and resilient operating profitability growth

kpis.name: DCC Energy Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the DCC Energy segment, primary growth driver for the group.
kpis.description: DCC Energy processed 15.2 billion liters of energy volume in 2025, flat year-over-year, consolidating its position as a leader in multimodal energy distribution.
kpis.signal: Stability in energy sales volume despite market variations

kpis.name: DCC Energy Adjusted Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit of the energy segment, representing 76% of group total profit.
kpis.description: DCC Energy generated adjusted operating profit of GBP 535.5 million in 2025, up 6.5%, demonstrating accelerated profitability of the energy segment driven by cost optimization and cleaner energy growth.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in core segment despite energy transition

kpis.name: DCC Technology Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the technology distribution segment.
kpis.description: DCC Technology recorded revenue of GBP 4.6 billion in 2025, up marginally by 0.3%, reflecting stability in the technology and consumer electronics distribution sector amid competitive pressures.
kpis.signal: Modest growth in technology distribution sector

kpis.name: DCC Technology Adjusted Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit of the technology distribution segment, representing 12% of total adjusted profit.
kpis.description: DCC Technology recorded adjusted operating profit of GBP 82.0 million in 2025, down 15.7%, reflecting integration costs from multiple major acquisitions completed in prior years.
kpis.signal: Temporary contraction due to recent acquisition integration

kpis.name: DCC Healthcare Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from the healthcare segment prior to divestiture.
kpis.description: DCC Healthcare recorded revenue of GBP 849.4 million in 2025, down 1.2%. The divestiture of this segment at GBP 1.050 billion was announced in April 2025, at a multiple 12x higher than the group's trading multiple.
kpis.signal: Segment under restructuring ahead of announced April 2025 divestiture

kpis.name: DCC Healthcare Adjusted Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Adjusted operating profit of the healthcare segment prior to divestiture.
kpis.description: DCC Healthcare generated adjusted operating profit of GBP 86.1 million in 2025, modestly down 2.3%. This performance valued the segment at GBP 1.050 billion upon its announced divestiture in April 2025.

kpis.name: Adjusted Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Adjusted earnings per share, excluding exceptional items.
kpis.description: Adjusted EPS stands at 470.2 pence in 2025, up 3.3% from 455.0 pence in the prior year, reflecting structural improvement in profitability.
kpis.signal: Sustained growth in shareholder remuneration per share

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Annual dividend per share paid to shareholders.
kpis.description: DCC increased its dividend per share to 206.40 pence in 2025, up 5.0% from 196.57 pence. The company has increased its dividend annually since IPO 31 years ago, with a CAGR of 12.9%.
kpis.signal: 31st consecutive year of dividend growth since stock exchange listing

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Free cash flow available for investments and shareholder distributions.
kpis.description: FCF stands at GBP 588.8 million in 2025, down 13.5% from GBP 681.1 million in the prior year, reflecting strategic investments and restructuring costs related to the energy-focused reorientation.
kpis.signal: Increased investment in operations and strategic restructuring

kpis.name: Return on Capital Employed
kpis.explanation: Return on invested capital, excluding the impact of IFRS 16 lease contracts.
kpis.description: ROCE reaches 15.3% in 2025, slightly down from 15.5% in the prior year but exceeding the group's 15% strategic target, reflecting efficient capital allocation and strong investment discipline.
kpis.signal: Performance exceeding cost of capital, group target maintained

kpis.name: Carbon Intensity
kpis.explanation: CO2 emissions per unit of energy distributed (gCO2e per MJ).
kpis.description: DCC Energy's carbon intensity stands at 73.4 gCO2e per MJ in 2025, improving 1.3% from 74.4 in the prior year, reflecting progress in the Cleaner Energy in Your Power strategy with growing share of cleaner energy and energy services.
kpis.signal: Gradual improvement in carbon intensity aligned with net zero strategy

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total consolidated employee count for DCC plc.
kpis.description: DCC employs 16,777 employees in 2025 (9,168 in DCC Energy, 4,347 in DCC Technology, 3,262 in DCC Healthcare), down slightly 1.1%, reflecting efficiency initiatives amid strategic transitions.
kpis.signal: Headcount optimization reflecting operational efficiency and restructuring readiness

kpis.name: Cleaner Energy Growth
kpis.explanation: Expansion of cleaner and renewable energy services segment.
kpis.description: DCC Energy progresses continuously in its Cleaner Energy in Your Power strategy, with sustained expansion of the energy services segment, positioning the group to capitalize on energy transition while maintaining presence in core essential markets.
kpis.signal: Diversification into sustainable energy solutions as long-term growth driver

kpis.name: DCC Healthcare Divestiture
kpis.explanation: Announced sale of DCC Healthcare at GBP 1.050 billion, representing 12x adjusted operating profit of 2024.
kpis.description: DCC announced in April 2025 the sale of DCC Healthcare at an enterprise value of GBP 1.050 billion, valuing the segment at 12x 2024 adjusted operating profit, significantly above the group's trading multiple, and immediately creating shareholder value.
kpis.signal: Successful implementation of energy-focused refocusing strategy with shareholder value creation

kpis.name: Shareholder Capital Return Program
kpis.explanation: Capital return of up to GBP 800 million to shareholders in 2025.
kpis.description: In addition to continued dividend growth (206.40 pence, +5.0%), DCC will return up to GBP 800 million of capital to shareholders in 2025, reflecting the strength of its balance sheet and confidence in the energy-focused strategy.
kpis.signal: Efficient capital deployment to shareholders beyond regular dividend

risks.title: Fuel spillage risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk is positioned centrally in the report, with strong language (material, zero harm target). Trend is stable but recurring in operations. Environment category is highly weighted in the energy sector.

risks.title: Exposure to physical climate risks
risks.score_rationale: Risk is documented with detailed analysis (IPCC scenarios through 2090), language is concerned but measured. Trend is upward. Environment category is critical to operations.

risks.title: Dependence on sensitive raw materials
risks.score_rationale: Risk is clearly identified in the biodiversity section, with cautious language. Trend is stable. Raw material dependence is a strategic lever but fragile.

risks.title: Proximity to high-biodiversity areas
risks.score_rationale: Risk is quantified (49 sites within 1km of a Key Biodiversity Area), language is factual. Trend is stable. Low incident history but localized exposure.

risks.title: Energy transition and regulatory risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk is central to strategy (pages 10-21), language is proactive but acknowledges pressure. Trend is upward. Emissions regulation is a key change driver.

risks.title: Competition in decarbonization solutions
risks.score_rationale: Risk is implicit in differentiation strategy, language is offensive. Trend is upward. Market for low-carbon energy services is expanding rapidly.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of energy infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: Not explicitly mentioned but inferred from operational risks on energy distribution and management systems. Trend is upward. Critical sector exposed to cyber threats.

ai_positioning.summary: DCC plc does not adopt an AI-centric positioning. The group operates in energy, technology distribution and healthcare (pre-divestiture) segments with strategic focus on distribution and operational optimization rather than AI as a key differentiator.
evidence: No mention of AI or machine learning algorithms in 2025 annual report
Strategy centered on operational efficiency, acquisition integration and energy transition
Value proposition based on multimodal distribution, cybersecurity and cost optimization
